```cypher
MATCH (p1:Plugin {component: 'mod_customcert'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p1)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m1:Maintainer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:Plugin {component: 'tool_certificate'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m2:Maintainer)
WITH p1, COLLECT(DISTINCT m1.display_name) AS maintainers_p1, p2, COLLECT(DISTINCT m2.display_name) AS maintainers_p2
RETURN p1.component, p1.installations AS installations_p1, maintainers_p1,
       p2.component, p2.installations AS installations_p2, maintainers_p2,
       CASE WHEN size(apoc.coll.intersection(maintainers_p1, maintainers_p2)) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS share_maintainers
LIMIT 100
```
